top1.title: 【2026-10-18】Anthropicの社内報告、若手採用の比率低下と会議時間の増加が明らかに
top1.lead1: AIを業務に深く組み込むAnthropicで、若手採用の比率低下と会議時間の増加が報告された。
top1.lead2: TechCrunchが社内報告を紹介。AIの出力が増えるなか、人間の判断力や対面での調整の重要性が浮かぶ。

top10.title: [2026-10-18] Internal Anthropic report reveals declining share of junior hires and increased meeting time
top10.summary: TechCrunch reported on an internal Anthropic report. The share of junior hires in technical roles has declined, while employees' meeting time has increased. Human judgment and coordination are emerging as challenges in workplaces where AI use is expanding.

top10.title: [2026-10-18] Meta removes wording from commercial terms that raised concerns over website scraping and AI training
top10.summary: Meta removed wording from its commercial terms that had been interpreted as allowing content from external websites to be used for AI training. The company explained that this clarified provisions for advertisers and businesses rather than changing its web scraping methods.

top10.title: [2026-10-18] [Editorial] Yomiuri Shimbun calls for government involvement and an industry-wide framework for US AI self-regulation
top10.summary: A Yomiuri Shimbun editorial argued that voluntary self-regulation without legal obligations is insufficient for the safety measures pursued by the US government and AI companies. It called for government involvement, industry-wide regulation and international risk management.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
